cards.question: Stop buying NEW evals when LIT's last 40 trades add up to less than 0R, and start again when a free Sim eval (the same bot on NinjaTrader Sim, Builder 50K rules) passes?
cards.why: A bad (2021-25-like) market eats eval fees: today's plan loses $667 a year there. This rule stops the buying while the strategy is cold; the accounts you already own keep trading.
cards.impact: 12 months, today's 4 accounts + re-buys: 2021-25-like -$667 -> -$202 (cash you may need $2,011 -> $1,357); market turns bad after 3 months +$377; 2026-like -$443 of $38,399 (-1%); 25%-of-2026 mix -$94 of $2,651. Today LIT's last 40 trades = +30R: nothing stops now.
cards.applies: a buy gate (no live trading change): money_plan / payout autopilot 'buy next eval' line + a Sim101 shadow eval on the PC (lead builds; paper only)
cards.risk: costs ~1% in a 2026-like market; it reacts slowly (40 trades = ~4 months), so in a sudden bad turn it saves less than the $300-drawdown rule would
cards.recommend_why: Pre-registered test: it cut the 2021-25-like loss 70% and helped when the market turns, for ~1% of the good-market money. Two simpler rules passed too (3 eval fails in a row; the business $300 under its peak) and are almost as good.

cards.question: Buy a 2nd Rapid EOD 25K eval ($97.20, LIT + ATLAS) now, AND stop all new eval buys whenever the business (payouts minus fees since today) is $300 under its best, restarting when a free Sim eval passes?
cards.why: A 2nd Rapid lane pays a lot in a good market but loses fees in a bad one; the $300 stop removes most of that bad-market cost.
cards.impact: 12 months (fresh paths): 2026-like $37,598 -> $58,813; market turns bad after 3 months $6,514 -> $9,394; 2021-25-like -$705 -> -$279; 25% mix $2,425 -> $2,480. Keep ~$1,300 cash for fees (p90).
cards.applies: buy 1 Rapid EOD 25K (owner, $97.20) + ADD_ACCOUNT 5; buy gate in money_plan (lead builds) + Sim101 shadow eval (paper)
cards.risk: post-hoc idea (picked after the pre-registered run; confirmed only on new paths of the same history); in the 25% mix the gain is ~$0, so most of the gain needs a 2026-like market; 5 of 5 funded slots used
cards.recommend_why: Better than today in every market tested on fresh paths, mostly a big upside if 2026 continues; the stop keeps the bad-market cost under today's.
